text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Aw man, that was so close.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No. Thank you so much for doing your best 
for the sake of my little sisters!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Still... you're not the type to give up 
easily, so I bet you'll try again before 
long~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I believe in you, so get it for me 
next time, okay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
